Task scheduling for multilingual NMT. No image classification or resolution/batch-size scheduling.

Explore-exploit LR schedule on image/NLP datasets (CIFAR mentioned). Explores LR design but does not address resolution or batch-size scheduling together.
Super-Convergence: foundational work on LR cycling and large learning rates (CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet). Core LR scheduling but no progressive resolution or batch-size scheduling.

Progressive patch-size curriculum learning on 3D medical image segmentation. Shares the progressive-scaling spirit but wrong task (segmentation vs. classification) and domain (medical vs. CIFAR-scale). No batch-size or warmup discussion.

Medical image enhancement. Unrelated to classifier training scheduling.
Inverse RL for imitation learning (MuJoCo/Adroit). No image classification or scheduling content.

EfficientNetV2 explicitly addresses progressive image-size increases during training on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet, with adaptive regularization (dropout, augmentation) at resolution switches to prevent accuracy drop. Trains from scratch in short/fast regimes. Directly tackles the accuracy-loss problem in progressive resolution. Does not clearly detail batch-size scheduling, warmup alignment, or normalized optimizers, limiting it to 2.
Transformer-based PET image reconstruction. Unrelated to image classification.
Test-time adaptation for medical segmentation. Excluded: (a) test-time tuning on new data violates rubric, (b) medical segmentation not classification, (c) wrong domain.
Fine-tuning strategies for pre-trained models on medical imaging. Excluded: requires pretrained weights and only fine-tunes at higher resolution post-pretraining.
